subject: Re: Negative cache kickoff — decision + readout plan
body:
Team,

With the production-scale numbers in from last week's run, decisions ahead of Friday's Q3 OKR lock:

1. We adopt the negative cache as the default negative-mining path for new dual-encoder training in graphs-retrieval, starting Q3. Final numbers: quality parity on benchmark A, +1.6 recall@10 on benchmark B at full corpus, 35% accelerator-time saving — slightly below the mid-scale 38% because the staggered brute-force arm ate some of the week, but the story holds.
2. Existing production retrievers migrate opportunistically at their next scheduled retrain, not on a forced schedule. Chiara's adoption guide plus Oyin's trainer config are the migration kit.
3. Q3 OKR filed as: 3 production retrievers migrated, portfolio retrieval-training spend down 25%.

Readout to Hana's staff on 06-29, closing out the window on time. Thanks all — this one delivered exactly what it said on the tin.

Anders
